text:
Amanda: FYI saw a short but nasty latency spike on dedicated-pool-2 during the 10:05 burst. p50 went from ~180ms to ~560ms for/chat-only requests. KV miss rate jumped.
Raj: timeline + affected model?
Amanda: spike ~2415678800-2415678840. Model: redwood/gpt-medium-awq-int8 (pinned). Mostly short prompts, lots of context switching.
Li: my hunch: packer hit an alignment case, we fell back from the AWQ group-packed kernel to the scalar GPTQ path and KV cache warmup coincided -> big tail.
Kyle: attaching a small profiler paste from the canary run around the event: 
```
prof.dump: 
  total_tokens: 12k
  kernel_time: 1.12s
  kernels:
    awq_grouppack_v2         18.9%  (expected fast path)
    gptq_scalar_fallback     62.3%  (hot slow path)
    kv_lookup                 9.0%
    prefetch/io              6.4%
  packer: failures=412, avg_pack_size=4.1
  kv_miss_rate: 0.27
```
Amanda: interesting that gptq_scalar_fallback dominates. packer failures=412 for ~12k tokens is bad.
Raj: can you share the exact runtime flags used earlier? need to repro locally.
Li: runtime config in canary: `--group-size=32 --packer=minimal --awq-calib=auto --kv-prefetch=off`
Raj: `--packer=minimal` is likely too strict for these interleaved short chats. fallback threshold is hit when partial groups appear.
Kyle: quick repro command I ran: `./inference_bench --model gpt-medium-awq-int8 --batch=1 --seq=64 --group-size=32 --prefetch=0 --trace-kernels > out.log`
CI Bot: perf-test #342 completed: regressions detected in gptq_scalar_fallback path (+210% median).
Amanda: proposal: 1) lower group-size to 16 for this pool, 2) enable packer prefetching (`--packer=prefetch`), 3) temporarily force kernel selection to awq_grouppack_v2 when packer success ratio > 0.8.
Li: +1. Also consider adding an opportunistic small-group fast-path (pack size 1-3) to avoid fallback on micro-asks.
Raj: I'll add a runtime override flag `--kernel-chooser=prefer_awq` guarded by an env var so we can canary quickly.
Kyle: I'll run a micro-benchmark sweep: group_size [8,16,24,32], packer modes [none,minimal,prefetch] and gather kernel ratios and kv_miss. will post CSV.
Amanda: can we also check calibration impact? AWQ auto-calib sometimes increases encode cost during cold start. maybe set `awq-calib=off` in the canary.
Li: good call. Calibration + packer prefetch might be competing for same memory/threads.
Raj: action items: 
- Amanda: spin canary with group_size=16, packer=prefetch, awq-calib=off on pool-2 (ETA 30m)
- Kyle: perf sweep + upload traces to /perf/2415678901/ (ETA 45m)
- Li: draft a short doc for packer heuristics edge cases (will add examples)
- Me(Raj): add `--kernel-chooser` flag and a fallback metric.
Amanda: thanks — please ping here when the canary is up. :thumbsup:
Kyle: quick note: if we still see high kv_miss_rate after these changes, we should look at request routing — small chats are likely hitting different workers and cold KV caches.
Amanda: noted.
Raj: on it. Will post repro logs + PR link once kernel-chooser is ready.
Amanda: thanks all.
